screens.cover: Christmas Traditions That Will Give Your Kids A Childhood They Never Forget…

screens.head: A Christmas Eve box.
body: New pyjamas, a Christmas film and a hot chocolate.
The night before the magic starts.

screens.head: A story every night in December.
body: 24 little books of the original Winnie-the-Pooh stories and poems, one each night.
They'll ask for it before bed, every single night.

screens.head: Matching pyjamas for the Christmas photo.
body: You'll laugh at those photos for years.

screens.head: A note for Father Christmas.
body: A mince pie for him, a carrot for Rudolph.
Then watch their faces in the morning.

screens.head: Christmas morning, no phones.
body: Just pyjamas, paper everywhere and too much chocolate.
Be there for all of it.

screens.head: One new decoration every year.
body: One day they'll hang them on their own tree and think of you.
